description: List the origin-country tables in the bundled official CBAM default-values dataset. Use this to discover country codes before cbam_get_default_values; this returns no emissions or product-specific values. Returns countries as code/name objects and the regulation source. The dataset changes when the bundled official acts are updated; countries without their own table use OTHER in cbam_get_default_values. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.
name: cbam_list_countries
title: List CBAM default-value countries
